race.description: Magain Fielke Real Estate Gawler Hcp (56)
race.comment: LUMBER DREAM (5) is a durable veteran who made the most of a very smart ride when scoring second up at Halidon 12 days ago. He meets another modest field, and from a superior gate, he may even repeat the dose. WIN TO RETIRE (9) has found it very hard to win another race, but she is never far from the action. We can't put her on top, but she is a must for all top 4 players. THE PUNK ROCKER (2) was an overdue maiden winner at Balaklava 9 days ago, and this field is not a big step up for him. Go again. HEAT OF THE NIGHT (12) has been thereabouts recently, and from her best draw in a while, she can figure in the top 3 here. HOTCH POTCH (6) strips fitter second up, and will benefit from a 4kg claim. He gets a nice swing in his draw, and can spice up any combinations.
